scholarships.title: KIIT University India Scholarships Programme (KUISP)
scholarships.official_source: Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) Deemed to be University

eligibility: Foreign national applicant, with SAARC citizens excluded in recent cycles
Good academic standing and completed previous academic levels
Applying to a KUISP-eligible undergraduate, postgraduate or doctorate programme, or a short-term training programme
Indian diplomatic missions may recommend a maximum of ten students from their country of accreditation
existing.eligibility_summary: Foreign national applicants, excluding SAARC citizens in recent cycles, applying to undergraduate, postgraduate or doctorate programmes, and also short-term training programmes, at KIIT Deemed to be University. Applicants need a valid passport, a good academic record and basic English proficiency. KIIT asks Indian embassies and missions to recommend a maximum of ten students from their country of accreditation.
benefits: Between 50% and 100% tuition fee scholarship for the whole course duration
Examination and registration fees covered for the whole course duration
coverage: Between 50% and 100% scholarship on tuition fees for the whole course duration
Examination and registration fees for the whole course duration
Free access to the student society
requirements: Apply through the KIIT International Admission Portal or by emailing the international office
Register on the KIIT International Admissions Portal, verify the email, and complete the programme-specific application form
KUISP applies to foreign national applicants for the academic year, across undergraduate, postgraduate, doctorate and short-term training programmes
documents: Scanned copy of the applicant's passport
Academic transcripts and certificates from previous institutions
Proof of English proficiency such as TOEFL or IELTS, if applicable and not compulsory
English-translated documents if the applicant is from a non-English-speaking country
existing.english_requirement: Proof of English proficiency such as TOEFL or IELTS is requested if applicable, and KIIT's own admissions guidance notes this is not compulsory. Documents from non-English-speaking countries must be translated into English.
application_method: Apply directly through the KIIT International Admission Portal at international.kiit.ac.in
Alternatively email the International Relations office at internationaloffice@kiit.ac.in
In some cycles, applications are routed through the recommendation of an Indian embassy or mission
existing.selection_notes: KIIT publishes 100 international scholarships in total, and its official scholarship page states that two students and ten students from each country are provided with full and half tuition fee waivers respectively. KIIT warns that the scholarship amount, eligibility conditions and duration may change from time to time and that applicants should refer to the latest university notification and applicable scheme guidelines before applying.
existing.best_fit: International applicants to KIIT who need tuition support but should budget separately for accommodation, food, airfare, visa, insurance and living costs, since KUISP does not cover them.
existing.notes: KUISP is explicitly not a fully funded award. The KIIT leaflet lists airfare tickets, visa fees, medical insurance, stipends, personal living expenses and laptops as not covered, and students remain responsible for accommodation and food charges. The stored record's funding description of partial to fully funded has been corrected to a tuition fee waiver for this reason.
existing.duration: For the whole duration of the chosen course, typically three, four or five years for undergraduate programmes, two years for postgraduate programmes and the full doctorate duration
existing.application_period: Annual. Recent cycles opened on 1 March and closed at the end of August of the same year, with Indian diplomatic missions also asked to recommend candidates by 30 September.
existing.deadline_display: No current official deadline could be retrieved. The KUISP leaflets for recent cycles stated "Application Start Date: 1st March" and "Application Deadline: 30th August" for that academic year, with applications free of charge. The equivalent window for the current academic year has already passed on the verification date.
existing.program_type: Tuition fee scholarship for international students across UG, PG and doctoral programmes
